plot_multivariate_gaussian: plot a 2D multivariate Gaussian distribution given a mean vector and covariance matrix using PyTorch
run_plot_kernel: run the plot_multivariate_gaussian function to generate a masked 2D Gaussian grid for visualization
test_plot_multivariate_gaussian: test the plot_multivariate_gaussian function with a 2D mean and covariance matrix on GPU
refactor_plot_kernel: refactor the plot_multivariate_gaussian function to support higher-dimensional covariance matrices
review_plot_multivariate_gaussian: review the plot_multivariate_gaussian function for numerical stability when inverting the covariance matrix
